title: vektor /// no. 044 — Vercel vs Netlify, static vs edge, preview vs production.
description: Six deployment terms that get used interchangeably and mean different things. Vercel is built around Next.js; Netlify is framework-agnostic with a build-plugin ecosystem. Static hosting serves every visitor the same pre-built file; edge functions run your code near the user and can answer each request differently. A preview deployment is a live URL per branch; production is what your users actually hit. The cheat sheet, one email away.
og_title: Vercel vs Netlify. Static vs edge. Preview vs production. — vektor /// no. 044
og_description: Three pairs people use interchangeably, and the cost of getting each one wrong: paying per-invocation for output a CDN would serve free, static-generating a page that needs to differ per user, reviewing on localhost instead of the preview URL.
